title: Grateful Dead Live at International Speedway on 1969-12-28

ai_review.summary: Rough but lively tape captures a high‑energy performance with a standout Mason’s Children jam despite noticeable distortion.
ai_review.review: The show is consistently praised for its energy and fun vibe, highlighted by the Mason's Children jam that fans rate highly. The recording, sourced from a soundboard, suffers from over‑driven levels and a beat‑up tape quality that introduces distortion, but listeners still find it enjoyable given the scarcity of material from this era.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers gave 4 stars and praised the performance while noting recording flaws; weighted assessment (70% show, 30% recording) yields a solid near‑4 rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Levels were too high causing noticeable distortion; tape is described as sketchy and beat‑up, resulting in limited fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall good show with high energy; fans feel the band “laid it down” throughout.
